articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Canal Park Food Pantry
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. To the editor: I have lived on Kiln Place for 19 years, and I want to say what a difference the Canal Park Food Pantry has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the September meeting. Please keep the accessible ramp in the budget. Many of us on Kiln Place use it every week.
Talia Iwasaki, Upper Commons
